simple.summary: עַצֻּמָה (ʻatstsumâh) means a bulwark , i.e. (figuratively) argument First listed occurrence: Isa 41 21.

definitions.full: H6110. atsumah [ עֲצֻמָה ] noun feminine defence ; — plural suffix עֲצֻמוֺתֵיכֻם (so Baer Ginsb; van d. H. ׳עַצֻּמ ) Isa 41:21 bring forward your defences , defensive arguments (Che Hpt עַצְּבוֺתֵיכֻם your idols , after Gr, [so Lo Klo explain ׳עצמ , as mightiest aid, I. עצם ]). (ה)עצנו 2Sam 23:8 , see I. עָדִין below I. עדן .
